title: Cargo.toml pins reqwest to rustls-tls-manual-roots with no system root bundle
description: Cargo.toml: reqwest uses feature 'rustls-tls-manual-roots' which provides rustls TLS but with NO built-in root certificate bundle. DefaultTransport calls reqwest::ClientBuilder::new().build() without adding any root certificates, so HTTPS connections from DefaultTransport will fail with TLS verification errors against public servers. This is almost certainly a bug introduced when the feature flag was chosen: 'rustls-tls-manual-roots' is the right choice only if the caller always supplies roots via add_root_certificate or with_native_certs(). The standard choice for public-CA HTTPS is 'rustls-tls' (which bundles webpki-roots) or 'rustls-tls-native-roots'. The existing integration tests use wiremock on localhost (HTTP, no TLS) so they do not catch this. Any user calling JmapClient::new_plain() against a real HTTPS server will get a TLS error. Maintenance consequence: every new user will file a 'cannot connect to server' issue.
